rules.statement: Every exposed operation MUST define authentication and server-enforced authorization, including resource ownership.
rules.verification: Positive and negative authorization tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Solutions MUST document threats, trust boundaries, data classification, and mitigation owners.
rules.verification: Threat model review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Browser applications MUST NOT contain confidential credentials and token/session handling MUST follow the documented identity design.
rules.verification: Bundle inspection and identity tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Sensitive data MUST have defined encryption, retention, deletion, and telemetry redaction controls.
rules.verification: Security and data lifecycle review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Solutions MUST decide whether browser access is same-origin or cross-origin before enabling CORS.
rules.verification: Deployment origin matrix and browser integration test
rules.applies_when: a browser interacts with an API

rules.statement: Cross-origin policies MUST use validated exact per-environment origins and explicit required capabilities.
rules.verification: Positive/negative preflight and production configuration tests
rules.applies_when: a browser interacts with an API

rules.statement: CORS MUST NOT substitute for authentication, authorization, or CSRF protection.
rules.verification: Unauthorized actual request and CSRF negative tests
rules.applies_when: a browser interacts with an API

rules.statement: Each solution MUST select and document its browser/workload identity profile and session lifecycle.
rules.verification: Identity ADR, logout/expiry integration tests
rules.applies_when: an application authenticates users or workloads

rules.statement: APIs MUST authenticate tokens for their intended audience and enforce resource/tenant authorization.
rules.verification: Wrong-audience and cross-tenant denial tests
rules.applies_when: an application authenticates users or workloads

rules.statement: Cookie-authenticated mutations MUST include independently verified CSRF protection.
rules.verification: Missing, invalid, and cross-session antiforgery tests
rules.applies_when: an application authenticates users or workloads

rules.statement: Agents MUST NOT introduce custom identity protocols or browser client secrets.
rules.verification: Dependency/configuration and browser bundle review
rules.applies_when: an application authenticates users or workloads

rules.statement: Exposed boundaries MUST validate inputs and mitigate applicable injection, SSRF, upload, and abuse risks.
rules.verification: Threat-linked negative tests
rules.applies_when: an application accepts untrusted data or handles protected information

rules.statement: Secrets and sensitive telemetry MUST have scoped access, rotation, redaction, and incident procedures.
rules.verification: Synthetic leak tests and revocation exercise
rules.applies_when: an application accepts untrusted data or handles protected information

rules.statement: Webhooks MUST authenticate payloads and prevent unauthorized replay before side effects.
rules.verification: Bad-signature, expired-timestamp, and replay tests
rules.applies_when: an application accepts untrusted data or handles protected information

rules.statement: Secrets MUST NOT be committed to source control, baked into container images, or emitted in logs, traces, or error responses.
rules.verification: Secret scanning with push protection enabled; image history inspection; redaction test on identity endpoints
rules.applies_when: an application, pipeline, or agent uses a credential, key, token, or connection string

rules.statement: Runtime and CI secrets MUST live in the platform secret store (Fly.io secrets, GitHub environment secrets) and be read from configuration at startup with fail-fast on absence.
rules.verification: Configuration review; startup test with a missing secret fails
rules.applies_when: an application, pipeline, or agent uses a credential, key, token, or connection string

rules.statement: Every secret MUST have a named owner, a rotation procedure, and a maximum age recorded in the application's secrets inventory.
rules.verification: Secrets inventory reviewed at release; rotation rehearsal evidence
rules.applies_when: an application, pipeline, or agent uses a credential, key, token, or connection string

rules.statement: A suspected leak MUST trigger revocation and replacement before history cleanup, with the exposure window reviewed and the incident recorded.
rules.verification: Incident record linked from the threat model
rules.applies_when: an application, pipeline, or agent uses a credential, key, token, or connection string

rules.statement: Every solution MUST maintain a threat model from the shared template, with one row per boundary and misuse case, updated in the same change that adds or alters a trust boundary, store, public contract, or identity flow.
rules.verification: Threat model file linked from the introducing PR; diagram matches deployed components
rules.applies_when: a solution adds or changes a trust boundary, persistent store, public contract, identity flow, or external integration

rules.statement: Each threat model row MUST map its mitigation to a handbook rule ID (or a solution ADR) and name a verification and a residual risk owner.
rules.verification: Review of the Rule, Verification, and Owner columns; cited tests exist and run in CI
rules.applies_when: a solution adds or changes a trust boundary, persistent store, public contract, identity flow, or external integration

rules.statement: Every GitHub Actions `uses:` reference MUST be pinned to a full commit SHA, with Dependabot configured for the `github-actions` ecosystem.
rules.verification: Workflow lint for SHA pins; `dependabot.yml` includes `github-actions`
rules.applies_when: a repository uses GitHub Actions to build, test, publish, or deploy

rules.statement: Workflows MUST declare top-level `permissions: contents: read` and widen permissions only in the jobs that need them.
rules.verification: Workflow review; no job inherits write permissions by default
rules.applies_when: a repository uses GitHub Actions to build, test, publish, or deploy

rules.statement: Deployments MUST authenticate with OIDC federation or short-lived scoped tokens stored as environment secrets, and production deploys MUST run in a protected environment restricted to `main`.
rules.verification: Environment protection settings; absence of long-lived provider keys in repository secrets
rules.applies_when: a repository uses GitHub Actions to build, test, publish, or deploy

rules.statement: Workflows MUST NOT execute code from untrusted pull requests with secrets or write permissions (`pull_request_target` with PR checkout), and release jobs MUST publish build provenance attestations for shipped artifacts.
rules.verification: Trigger review; `gh attestation verify` succeeds for each released artifact
rules.applies_when: a repository uses GitHub Actions to build, test, publish, or deploy

rules.statement: Repositories MUST commit lockfiles, restore in locked mode in CI, pin container base images by digest, and run automated dependency updates (Dependabot or Renovate) on at least a weekly schedule for every ecosystem they use.
rules.verification: Lockfiles present; CI restore uses locked mode; `dependabot.yml` or `renovate.json` covers nuget, npm, docker, and github-actions as applicable
rules.applies_when: a repository declares third-party packages (NuGet, npm, container base images, GitHub Actions)

rules.statement: CI MUST fail on High or Critical vulnerabilities in direct or transitive dependencies, and fixes MUST ship within the severity SLA or carry a documented reachability note or exception.
rules.verification: `dotnet list package --vulnerable` and `npm audit` run in CI; alert triage notes; exception records for overdue items
rules.applies_when: a repository declares third-party packages (NuGet, npm, container base images, GitHub Actions)

rules.statement: Every release MUST publish a CycloneDX SBOM per deployable artifact and MUST pass a license check against the allow-list.
rules.verification: SBOM attached to the release; license check job green or reviewed
rules.applies_when: a repository declares third-party packages (NuGet, npm, container base images, GitHub Actions)
